review.summary: The spec introduces new roles and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json. While these are proposed future-state designs, they should be clearly labeled as such to avoid confusion.

findings.title: Ungrounded Future-State Roles and Data Models
findings.evidence: The spec introduces new roles (`client_officer`, `client_admin`) and data models (normalized membership table) that are not present in the current system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Label all proposed future-state designs as such and ensure they do not falsely claim existing implementation.

verificationChecks: Ensure all new roles and data models are clearly labeled as proposed future work

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
